stories.summary: Airbus and India-based Blue Angels Air have launched a partnership to train airline pilots for the Indian market. Cadets will undergo the Airbus Ab Initio syllabus, which is recognized by the European Union Aviation Safety Agency. The program includes a specific focus on women in aviation.

Cadets will complete an Ab Initio syllabus aligned with European Union Aviation Safety Agency standards before meeting Indian licence conversion requirements. The partnership also focuses on advancing gender diversity in aviation.
